reviews.text: Joe and his team just did an outstanding job mulching my entire property. Communication leading up to the day off was stellar, they were efficient, and prices were very competitive. I would certainly use "The Wiz" again for other landscaping or handywork project. Worth a quote for something you want done, he's a master of his craft.

Joe painted and refinished our garage, and created a custom entry wall coat rack with decorative paneling. He works very hard and is very accommodating. I would highly recommend him for any job or service you’re considering him for!
Joe is simply the best. His work is exceptional and he always goes the extra mile. Reasonably priced and dependable. You will not find a better landscaper than Joe the Wiz!!!!
